description: Summary figure: SDD3 M16 architecture, zinc site geometry, ortholog conservation and proteolytic chamber
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, numpy as np
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13,7.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=0.55,wspace=0.32)

# A: motif architecture
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.set_xlim(0,1037); ax.set_ylim(0,1); ax.axis("off")
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.42),1036,0.16,fc="#E8E8E8",ec="k",lw=0.8))
for s,e,c,lab in [(7,247,"#4C72B0","M16 domain 1"),(259,511,"#6FA8DC","domain 2"),(815,1036,"#9FC5E8","domains 3-4")]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,0.42),e-s,0.16,fc=c,ec="k",lw=0.6))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,0.5,lab,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8)
for p,lab,c in [(60,"H60",'#C44E52'),(63,"E63",'#DD8452'),(64,"H64",'#C44E52'),(135,"E135",'#937860'),(153,"E153",'#C44E52')]:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.58,0.70],c=c,lw=1.5); ax.text(p,0.73,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8,color=c,rotation=0)
ax.text(0,0.26,"SDD3 / YOL098C (Q12496), 1037 aa   |   MEROPS M16.A04 (unassigned peptidase)   |   motif  H60-T-L-E63-H64  (inverted HxxEH, clan ME)",fontsize=9)
ax.text(0,0.10,"red = zinc ligands, orange = catalytic Glu (proton acceptor), brown = second active-site Glu",fontsize=8,color="#555")
ax.set_title("A   SDD3 domain architecture and predicted M16 catalytic machinery",loc="left",fontsize=11)

# B: zinc geometry
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
lig=["His60\nNE2","His64\nNE2","Glu153\nOE2","Glu63\n(catalytic)"]
d=[2.05,2.05,2.05,5.51]
ax.bar(lig,d,color=["#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#DD8452"])
ax.axhspan(1.9,2.3,color="green",alpha=.15); ax.axhline(2.1,ls="--",c="green",lw=1)
ax.text(3.4,2.45,"Zn-ligand\nbond range",fontsize=7,color="green",ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("Distance to fitted Zn (A)"); ax.set_ylim(0,6.5)
ax.set_title("B   Zinc site geometry,\nAlphaFold model (mean pLDDT 93.7)",loc="left",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# C: conservation
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
S=pd.read_csv("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/sdd3_conservation_summary.csv")
lab=[f"{r.position}{r.expected}" for r in S.itertuples()]
b=ax.bar(lab,S.pct,color=["#4C72B0","#DD8452","#4C72B0","#937860","#4C72B0"])
for bb,r in zip(b,S.itertuples()): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,r.pct+1.5,f"{r.n_conserved}/{r.n_covered}",ha="center",fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylim(0,115); ax.set_ylabel("% conserved")
ax.set_title("C   Conservation across 31-32\nhomologs covering the site",loc="left",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# D: chamber
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
T=pd.read_csv("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/chamber_comparison.csv")
b=ax.bar(["SDD3\n(predicted)","PITRM1 4L3T\n(control)"],T.buried_vol_A3,color=["#8172B3","#55A868"])
for bb,v in zip(b,T.buried_vol_A3): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,v+200,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(10000,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(1.45,10300,"published ~10,000 A$^3$",fontsize=7,ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("Enclosed chamber volume (A$^3$)"); ax.set_ylim(0,12500)
ax.set_title("D   Buried proteolytic chamber\nlined by the zinc site",loc="left",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
plt.show()
